name: Expanding Carousel
description: Row of portrait cards where one card is expanded with a name and title overlay while the others collapse into narrow strips. Autoplays, rotates on click, and has arrow and dot navigation.
contents: Row of image cards with one expanded active card showing title and name over a gradient
Previous and next buttons with dot indicators
behavior: Autoplay rotates the card list on an interval and pauses briefly after manual input
Clicking a collapsed card or dot rotates it into the active position
Width, saturation and brightness of cards transition smoothly with distance from the active card
Card widths scale with viewport width on small screens
editableByProps: Slides with image, name and title
Starting active position, autoplay and interval
Card sizes, radius, gap, height and transition speed
Background, accent color, fonts and font sizes
Navigation visibility and slide change callback

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the shadow of the active card
needsCodeEdit.where: boxShadow style in the list.map card
backgroundImage data URL on the absolute inset-0 div

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how inactive images are dimmed
needsCodeEdit.where: sat and bri constants in the list.map

fixed: Loads Cormorant Garamond and DM Sans through a Google Fonts import inside the component style tag
Slide names are used as keys and must be unique
Root uses h-full, so the parent needs a height for vertical centering
